title: Disable Microsoft Edge startup boost and background mode (documented policies)
description: Sets two documented Microsoft Edge group policies under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge: StartupBoostEnabled=0 (no Edge preload at boot) and BackgroundModeEnabled=0 (Edge stops running in the background after the last window closes). Catalog 18 keeps Edge operations to documented mechanisms only; uninstalls or hacks are out of scope by design. The previous values and their types are captured in a snapshot and restored by per-feature undo.
